steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each rate and assumption is matched to its source; the provision is checked against its workings.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Tax rate with no source
findings.fix: Cite the rate from the tax authority

findings.title: Provision does not follow from its workings

outcome.notChecked: The tax law; the tax position of the organisation.

pros: Checks a rate with no source, a provision that does not follow from its workings, and an assumption with no stated basis.
cons: Not checked: The tax law; the tax position of the organisation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-tax-provision-review skill on the records for this review.
